Where each part's footprint lies within its whole's and the two parts' footprints share nothing, what the leaves of a realized plan draw on, joined, repeats nothing and lies within the root's footprint (JointPlan.supports_of_realizes); realized_requests_supported is that law (realized_requests_supported_by_core), with no added hypothesis and empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The converse fails with nothing more: the root's footprint can support every leaf where no whole holds any part (Unjoined.supports_not_realizes), the record's limitation witnessed on the spine. The list model of realize_iff_supported and the periphery receipt keep their scope.
